current.analysis: Microsoft Learn exact current reference and pinned REST 2026-07-01 managedClusters.json were fetched and parsed. The PUT operation path is /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/{resourceName}; resourceName is required string. ManagedCluster.name is string; existing declarations reference the identified resource and do not provide creation-only required location.

ga.analysis: Learn current reference version selector lists 2026-08-01 as stable and the fixed-commit tree search found 2026-08-01 as the highest stable managedClusters.json path. The exact candidate swagger has info.version 2026-08-01; its required string resourceName route and ManagedCluster.name string match current. The candidate removes other model properties, none used by these Bicep declarations.

breaking.analysis: Learn managedClusters change log entry for 2026-08-01 lists removed models/properties (including BastionProfile, kubeProxyConfig, CreationData, control-plane/health-monitor/ingress/security/node-disruption properties and upgradeGateSettings). All seven declarations use name for existing resource identity; scope is Bicep scope control, and header/variables/comments are not REST body fields. No removed field is used. Change log reviewed in full around the candidate entry.
